narr: Widespread thunderstorms developed across eastern Oklahoma during the evening hours of the 13th and early morning hours of the 14th, as a cold front moved through the region. The strongest thunderstorms produced damaging wind gusts. Locally heavy rainfall resulted in some flash flooding.
ev: Several roads were flooded in and around Ottawa.
Portions of several roads were flooded northeast of Afton.
Portions of several roads were flooded northeast of Big Cabin.
Portions of several roads in and around Vinita were flooded.
Portions of several roads were flooded southwest of Big Cabin.
Several roads were flooded in a neighborhood on the northeast side of Tulsa.
